subject: planner: move PhysicalIndexLookupReader related logic into physical op dir (#62935)
summary: This commit refactors `PhysicalIndexLookUpReader` by moving its definition and most methods from `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop`, exporting key fields (`IndexPlan`/`TablePlan`, `ExpectedCnt`/`KeepOrder`) and updating all executor/planner call sites accordingly. Costing and ResolveIndices logic are kept in `core` and bridged via new `utilfuncp` function pointers wired in `pkg/planner/core/core_init.go`; behavior appears preserved with no plausible remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the touched planner/executor paths.
